If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecasted price by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecasted price by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to counteract pessimism.

If sentiment shifts from positive to negative mid-horizon (day 8–15), reduce forecast by 1–2% to reflect sentiment reversal risk.

If sentiment is mixed (±0.33) in the last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% upward adjustment to mid-horizon (day 16–21) forecasts to hedge against volatility.

If sentiment is consistently positive in late horizon (day 22–30) and price is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% to avoid overcorrection.

If sentiment is consistently negative in late horizon and price is trending downward, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% to avoid underestimating downside risk.
